admission_summary.conclusion: RFC 1123 has one fixed FTP timing floor (a default idle timeout of at least five minutes), but the locked LightFTP server has neither an idle-timeout configuration field nor an idle-timeout execution path. RFC 959 timing-like replies and waits supply no universal numeric bound.

standards.title: Requirements for Internet Hosts -- Application and Support

method: Exhaustive numeric-timing screening of RFC 959 greetings, delayed-service replies, command/reply sequencing, connection closure language, and RFC 1123 FTP idle/response timeout requirements. Source searches covered timeout, idle, socket timeout options, select/poll/alarm, configuration parsing, and control-loop receive/close paths.

screening_records.numeric_rule: A Server-FTP SHOULD have a configurable idle timeout whose default is at least five minutes.
source_evidence: Source/ftpserv.h:36-45 defines FTP_CONFIG without an idle-timeout field.
Source/main.c:91-128 parses all server configuration fields and no idle timeout.
Source/ftpserv.c:1822-1854 uses blocking recv/gnutls_record_recv without an idle deadline.
Source/ftpserv.c:1913-1969 closes the control connection only after receive/command termination.

screening_records.numeric_rule: Program-invoked User-FTP clients need response timeouts, but no value is specified.
source_evidence: The locked target is a server and contains no User-FTP response timer.

screening_records.numeric_rule: Reply 120 announces service ready in nnn minutes; nnn is supplied per reply and has no default.
source_evidence: Source/ftpserv.h:149-196 defines the fixed reply strings; it has 220 but no 120 delayed-service reply.

screening_records.numeric_rule: The server sends a prompt primary reply and the client waits, but no elapsed-time bound is specified.
source_evidence: Source/ftpserv.c:1913-1953 dispatches commands and their replies without a standard-derived response deadline.

screening_records.numeric_rule: The phrase 'a few hours later' guides 4xx versus 5xx reply classification; it is not a timer obligation.
source_evidence: The text supplies neither endpoints nor a timed state transition that can be projected to a finite pointwise formula.

verification.idle_timer_source_search_result: No FTP control-connection idle timer or configuration field found.
